hypothesis: dup_n sizes its allocation with `unsigned short total = n + 1`, which wraps to 0 at n=65535 while the subsequent memcpy still writes n bytes. A benign short length returns a correctly sized buffer; the maximum unsigned-short length overflows the allocation and writes out of bounds, which AddressSanitizer reports as a heap-buffer-overflow in dup.c.

plan.objective: Show that an in-range length is handled correctly while the maximum unsigned-short length overflows the size calculation
